text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon and I go to the year-end grand prix, the Arima Kinen, where she finds herself overwhelmed by all the excitement.
Daiwa Scarlet wins the race, and the winning concert with her at the center is truly breathtaking.
After watching from the front row, Smart Falcon is determined to make her next race, the Tokyo Daishoten, just as exciting.
She reassures herself that dirt racing does deserve the hype, and that she's done everything she can to build it up.
